cities.title: Cities / counties
cities.description: Pick one or more jurisdictions. Leave empty (and leave States empty) to search all of them.

enumTitles: Baton Rouge (East Baton Rouge Parish), LA
Collin County (Plano, Frisco, McKinney, Allen...), TX

states.title: States / provinces
states.description: Adds every supported jurisdiction in these states, e.g. TX adds Austin, Dallas, San Antonio and Collin County.

lastNDays.title: Issued in the last N days
lastNDays.description: Ignored when 'Issued from' is set. Cities publish with a 1-7 day lag, so 7+ days is safest for daily schedules.

dateFrom.title: Issued from
dateFrom.description: First issue date to include (YYYY-MM-DD). Overrides 'last N days'.

dateTo.title: Issued until
dateTo.description: Last issue date to include (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

trades.title: Trades
trades.description: Keep permits whose work matches any of these trades. Leave empty for all permits.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keep permits whose type, description or contractor contains any of these words (case-insensitive).

zipCodes.title: ZIP / postal codes
zipCodes.description: Keep permits in these ZIP codes. A prefix works too: '787' matches all of 787xx.

minProjectValue.title: Minimum project value ($)
minProjectValue.description: Drops permits below this value, and permits from cities that do not publish a value.

requireContact.title: Require contact details
requireContact.description: Only keep permits that name a contractor, or that have a phone number.

excludeOwnerBuilder.title: Exclude owner-builder permits
excludeOwnerBuilder.description: Skip permits where the owner is doing the work themselves.

outputMode.title: Output
outputMode.description: Permits: one row per permit. Contractors: one row per contractor with permit count, value and trades. Both: permits plus contractor rows.

onlyNew.title: Only permits not delivered before
onlyNew.description: Remembers delivered permits between runs, so scheduled runs only return (and charge for) new ones.

stateKey.title: Memory name for 'only new'
stateKey.description: Use a different name per schedule, so each schedule remembers its own permits.

maxResultsPerCity.title: Max permits per city
maxResultsPerCity.description: Newest permits first. Also caps the permits used for the contractor summary.

maxResults.title: Max permits in total
maxResults.description: 0 = no overall limit (the per-city limit still applies).

includeRaw.title: Include raw source record
includeRaw.description: Adds the original row from the city's portal under 'raw'.

socrataAppToken.title: Socrata app token (optional)
socrataAppToken.description: Your own free Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Not needed for normal use.

healthCheck.title: Health check only
healthCheck.description: Checks that each selected source answers and how recent its newest permit is. Writes the HEALTH record; returns no permits.
